quarterly_data.signal: Karan Batta (SVP, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) sized the distributed-cloud footprint: Oracle now has 'probably over 50 to 70 dedicated regions and Oracle Alloys that are deployed globally' - the same code and same set of services, deployed as public cloud, dedicated region in a customer facility, Cloud@Customer next to an Oracle Exadata box, sovereign cloud, or partner cloud via Oracle Alloy. He framed distributed cloud (AI coming to the data rather than the data moving) as a significant differentiator for OCI.
quarterly_data.figure: over 50 to 70 dedicated regions and Oracle Alloys that are deployed globally
